description: Schedules a new maintenance window. During maintenance, affected monitors are suppressed and show MAINTENANCE status instead of DOWN.

active.description: Whether the window is active (default: true)

dateRange.description: Date range as [startISO, endISO] (required for single strategy)

daysOfMonth.description: Days of month (1-31) for recurring-day-of-month strategy

description.description: Description or reason for the maintenance

intervalDay.description: Interval in days for recurring-interval strategy

strategy.description: Scheduling strategy: single=one-time, recurring-interval=every N days, recurring-weekday=specific weekdays, recurring-day-of-month=specific dates, manual=manually activated

timeRange.description: Start and end time within the day as [{hours, minutes}, {hours, minutes}]

weekdays.description: Days of week (0=Sunday … 6=Saturday) for recurring-weekday strategy

name: createMaintenance
title: Create Maintenance
